description: Figure 3 is a bar chart titled “Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets.” The horizontal axis (x-axis) represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with each year labeled. The vertical axis (y-axis) represents the “Number of datasets,” scaled from 0 to 100 in increments of 20. The chart displays two sets of vertical bars for each year: blue bars representing datasets that are “Targeted” (i.e., those that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition or publications), and orange bars representing “Untargeted” datasets (all other datasets that do not meet these criteria). The legend, located in the upper left corner, identifies the blue bars as “1” (Targeted) and the orange bars as “2+” (Untargeted). The chart shows a general upward trend in the number of datasets over time, with a notable increase in both targeted and untargeted datasets from 2018 onward, peaking in 2021. The caption notes that data for 2022 is only partially available.
